_comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for the Unakin business toolkit. Edit values here, then run `node business/build.mjs` to regenerate filled docs into business/dist/. Tokens like {{studio.legalName}} in any template get replaced. Anything in [BRACKETS] inside a doc is intentionally bespoke — edit it by hand per engagement.

studio.einNote: EIN on file — provided on W-9
studio._signatoryComment: Client-facing docs read as 'Unakin' (entity-first). A contract still needs a human to sign in their legal capacity — that's the ONLY place a personal name appears.
studio.pedigree: Led by a senior design & engineering team with 20 years at Apple and Microsoft

classes.commercial: Full rack rate. Corporations and funded businesses. No standing discount.
classes.smb: Rack rate; a capped, time-boxed courtesy may be extended at the studio's discretion.
classes.player: Sliding-scale courtesy off rack for friends and the rope team (fellow climbers/creators). Invite-only. Rack value is always shown; the courtesy is itemized as a gift.
classes.nonprofit: Reduced rate or pro-bono allocation for registered nonprofits and mission work.
classes.barter: Value-for-value trade (guided expeditions, gear, cross-promotion). Fair market value documented both directions. NOTE: barter is taxable income at FMV — CPA review required.

kaf.project: Immersive 3D Trail Fly-By Web App + White-Label Embed CMS
